TS049 trivial-assert

An assertion that cannot fail carries no information and hides the check it was meant to make.

languages: go javascript odin python rust typescript zig
severity: warning
default: opt-in
group: stable

NASA P10 Rule 5: "Any assertion for which a static checking tool can prove that it can never fail or never hold violates this rule. (I.e., it is not possible to satisfy the rule by adding unhelpful "assert(true)" statements.)"
